questions.q: In this course's framing, what does "orchestration" refer to?
options: The specific model you choose to call, such as GPT-4 or a fine-tuned classifier
The layer that decides when a step runs, what data it receives, and where the result goes next
The visual theme applied to the Power Automate designer
A synonym for prompt engineering
questions.explain: Orchestration is the layer around the model call itself — deciding timing, data flow, and routing — not the model call or its prompt.

questions.q: Why does the lesson say most AI automation projects actually fail?
options: The models are not accurate enough to be useful
Connectors don't exist for the systems being automated
On reliability concerns like retries, run history, and approval gates, not the model call itself
Power Automate cannot call external AI services
questions.explain: The lesson argues the hard part is making a pipeline reliable — retries, logging, human approval — not the act of calling a model.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what is Power Automate's relationship to code you write with something like LangChain?
options: Power Automate replaces the need for any reasoning code
They are mutually exclusive and cannot be used together
Power Automate wraps and connects around your reasoning code; it doesn't replace it
LangChain code must be rewritten entirely inside Power Automate flows
questions.explain: Power Automate is positioned as the connective tissue — getting data in and decisions out — around a reasoning layer that can still live in your own code.

questions.q: What underlying engine does Power Automate share with Azure Logic Apps, according to the lesson?
options: They share no underlying technology at all
The same workflow engine, which is why concepts like retries and run-after carry over
Both are built entirely on Azure Functions bindings
Power Automate is a renamed version of Azure DevOps Pipelines
questions.explain: Power Automate is built on the same underlying workflow engine as Azure Logic Apps, so core reliability concepts transfer almost directly.

questions.q: Who is Castlebridge Logistics, as introduced in this lesson?
options: A real client case study used for legal disclosure purposes
The fictional example company used throughout this course for realistic scenarios
The name of a Power Automate connector
A competitor product to Power Automate
questions.explain: Castlebridge Logistics is a fictional mid-size trucking and warehousing company used as a running example throughout this course.
